授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）:
将来、国際チームでビジネスや研究開発を行う科学者やエンジニアに必要なビジネスコミュニケーションを参加型ワークショップの形式で学ぶ授業です。就職活動のために必要な「ビジネス日本語」からグローバルビジネスのためのコミュニケーション・スキルまでを上級の日本語の学習ととっもに学びます。
この授業のカリキュラムは、今注目を浴びる世界で最も刺激的なビジネスデザインスクール・KAOSPILOTのプロフェッショナルプログラムが提唱する「Learning Arch Design」により構築されています。この授業の受講者は、経験学習（Experimental Learning）により日本語でのビジネスコミュニケーションスキルを身につけながら、実際に国際チームに作り、グループワークを行います。この授業独自のユニークな意識変容の学習（Transformative Learning）を通して、履修生の自己成長に導きます。　日本人の学生も受講可能な内容になっています。
本授業は次の４つのモジュールと2回のランゲージ・コーチング、2回のグループセッションと最終発表で構成されます。
モジュール１：自分を理解する
モジュール２：異文化を理解する
モジュール３：チームを理解する
モジュール４：組織を理解する
オンラインでの双方向授業
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）:
In this course, students will develop essential business communication skills crucial for scientists and engineers working in international teams for business and research and development (R&D) in the future. The curriculum is designed to equip students with practical skills, ranging from "business Japanese" for job hunting to advanced communication strategies suitable for global business environments. The course follows the "Learning Arch Design" methodology, which is advocated by KAOSPILOT, one of the world's most innovative business design schools known for its cutting-edge approach. Throughout the course, students will cultivate their Global Dexterity skills, learning to effectively adapt their communication and behavior to engage in diverse cultural settings. Participants will gain business communication skills in Japanese through experiential learning, teamwork in international groups, and collaborative projects. This transformative learning experience aims to promote personal growth. While the primary focus is on non-Japanese students, the course content is also available to Japanese students. The course is structured into four modules, supported by two language coaching sessions and two group sessions, culminating in a final presentation.
Module Breakdown:
- Module 1: Understanding Yourself
- Module 2: Understanding Different Cultures
- Module 3: Understanding the Team
- Module 4: Understanding the Organization
By the end of the course, students will have acquired business communication skills in the Japanese language and a comprehensive understanding of international team dynamics and organizational communication, preparing them to thrive in a global business environment with the flexibility and adaptability that Global Dexterity provides The curriculum of this class is built on the "Learning Arch Design" advocated by the professional program of KAOSPILOT, the world's most exciting business design school currently attracting attention. Participants in this class acquire business communication skills in Japanese through experiential learning (Experimental Learning), forming an international team, and doing group work. Through the unique transformative learning of this class, we will lead our students to self-growth.　The content is also available to Japanese students.
This class consists of four modules, two language coaching, two group sessions, and a final presentation.
Module 1: Understand yourself
Module 2: Understanding different cultures
Module 3: Understanding the team
Module 4: Understanding the organization
